div.span:
1. Building owners reach the portal through the web firewall and content delivery, signing in with MFA.
2. Production pushes approved summaries into the hours drop box, one-way.
3. Logs go to the Log Archive account, which nobody here can change.

4. Findings and alerts go to the Security / Audit account.
5. Restricted staff run and support the portal.

NOTE:
This account can never call Production. Owners see summaries only:no Social
